moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League continues this weekend with Matchweek 3 fixtures, including Newcastle v Bournemouth and Man City v Coventry today, and Everton v Man Utd and Arsenal v Chelsea tomorrow.

angles.name: Saturday Recap / Sunday Preview
angles.copy: Full-throttle Premier League action continues! Catch up on today's goals and get ready for tomorrow's big clashes: Everton v Man Utd and Arsenal v Chelsea. Who are you backing?

angles.name: London Derby Angle
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Chelsea – it's the London derby everyone's talking about tomorrow! Where will you be watching the drama unfold?

moments.title: FOMO Fest in Suffolk
moments.blurb: Today is the final day of FOMO Fest at Stowmarket's Food Museum, a family-friendly music festival with two stages, a funfair, and street food.

angles.name: Last Chance FOMO
angles.copy: Don't miss out! Today's your last chance to catch FOMO Fest in Stowmarket with two stages of music and family fun. Who's there?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Festival season isn't over yet! FOMO Fest wraps up today in Stowmarket. Good vibes, great music, and family fun.

moments.title: British Country Music Festival Concludes
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival in Blackpool concludes today, having featured acts like Elles Bailey as a headliner.

angles.name: Country Music Wrap
angles.copy: It's the final day of the British Country Music Festival in Blackpool! Who's been there for the boots and anthems?

angles.name: Elles Bailey Shoutout
angles.copy: Elles Bailey brought the house down at the British Country Music Festival! What a weekend for UK Americana.

moments.title: Bon Jovi at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: Bon Jovi continue their series of electrifying shows at Wembley Stadium in London this week, with dates on September 6th and 9th.

angles.name: Still Rocking Wembley
angles.copy: Bon Jovi are still rocking Wembley! If you're heading to the shows on Sep 6th or 9th, get ready for some stadium-sized anthems.

angles.name: Living on a Prayer
angles.copy: It's not too late to catch Bon Jovi at Wembley this week! Get ready to sing 'Living on a Prayer' at the top of your lungs.

moments.title: Tituss Burgess Live in London
moments.blurb: Broadway and screen sensation Tituss Burgess performs a one-night-only show at London's Cadogan Hall on Sunday, September 6th.

angles.name: Broadway in London
angles.copy: From Broadway to Cadogan Hall! Tituss Burgess brings his powerhouse vocals and hilarious stories to London tomorrow night. An unmissable evening!

angles.name: One Night Only
angles.copy: Don't miss your chance to see the incredible Tituss Burgess live at Cadogan Hall tomorrow for a special one-off performance!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Pink!
moments.blurb: Pop-rock superstar Pink (Alecia Beth Moore) celebrates her 47th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Pink Turns 47
angles.copy: Get the party started! Pop icon Pink turns 47 on September 8th. What's your all-time favourite Pink track?

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Still got it! Celebrating the incredible Pink's 47th birthday on Tuesday. A true rock and roll force.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Wiz Khalifa!
moments.blurb: American rapper Wiz Khalifa (Cameron Thomaz) celebrates his 39th birthday on September 8th.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Roll up, roll up! Wishing a very happy 39th birthday to rapper Wiz Khalifa on September 8th. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Aimee Mann!
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Aimee Mann, known for her solo work and 'Til Tuesday, turns 66 on September 8th.

angles.name: Indie Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Aimee Mann on September 8th! Her lyrical genius still shines.

moments.title: Todd Rundgren in London (Sold Out)
moments.blurb: Rock legend Todd Rundgren performs at Cadogan Hall in London on September 9th as part of his 'Damned If I Do' tour, though tickets are sold out.

angles.name: Prog Legend in Town
angles.copy: Sold out, but still a huge moment! Todd Rundgren brings his 'Damned If I Do' tour to London's Cadogan Hall on Wednesday. Who wishes they had a ticket?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ludacris!
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper and actor Ludacris (Christopher Brian Bridges) celebrates his 49th birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Luda's Big Day
angles.copy: Move Bitch, get out the way for Ludacris's 49th birthday on September 11th! What's your favourite Luda anthem?

moments.title: Reminisce Festival Returns
moments.blurb: The Reminisce Festival, a huge celebration of 90s and 00s dance music nostalgia, takes place at Sherdley Park, St Helens on Saturday, September 12th, featuring acts like Vengaboys and Basshunter.

angles.name: 90s/00s Dance Extravaganza
angles.copy: Get ready for a trip down memory lane! Reminisce Festival hits St Helens next Saturday with Vengaboys, Basshunter & more! Who's going?

angles.name: Throwback Festival
angles.copy: Your weekend plans are sorted! Reminisce Festival on Sep 12th is bringing back all the classic dance anthems from the 90s and 00s. Pure nostalgia!

moments.title: BBC Proms Nears Its End
moments.blurb: The iconic BBC Proms season at the Royal Albert Hall concludes on Saturday, September 12th.

angles.name: Last Night of the Proms Week
angles.copy: The final week of the BBC Proms is here, culminating in the Last Night of the Proms next Saturday. Have you been enjoying the classical spectacular?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Playboi Carti!
moments.blurb: American rapper Playboi Carti (Jordan Carter) turns 30 on September 13th.

angles.name: Carti's 30th
angles.copy: Celebrating Playboi Carti's 30th birthday on September 13th! Drop your favourite Carti track to celebrate.

moments.title: Indian Summer on the Horizon?
moments.blurb: Parts of the UK, particularly the south and east, could experience a late summer warm spell with temperatures potentially reaching 26C around September 16th.

angles.name: Warm Weather Ahead
angles.copy: Don't pack away the shorts just yet! An Indian Summer could bring temperatures up to 26C to parts of the UK around September 16th. Who's ready for more sunshine?

angles.name: Devon & Cornwall Sunshine?
angles.copy: Could Devon and Cornwall get a slice of next week's predicted warm spell? Temperatures might be climbing across the UK!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its launch show on Saturday, September 19th, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe, and Josh Widdicombe.

angles.name: Strictly's Back!
angles.copy: It's time to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is officially on September 19th with new hosts and a fresh format. Are you ready for the glitterball?

angles.name: New Strictly Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Johannes Radebe & Josh Widdicombe take the helm for the new series of Strictly, starting Sep 19th! Excited for the new presenting line-up?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Back Soon
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 on Tuesday, September 24th, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: Get ready to pre-heat your ovens! The Great British Bake Off returns September 24th with new judge Nigella Lawson. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge when Great British Bake Off returns on September 24th! What do you think of the new addition?
